;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[2019 Ethiopian clashes]]
**The death toll of recent clashes in the [[Oromia Region]] of [[Ethiopia]] rises to 86. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-ethiopia-politics/ethiopia-pm-abiy-says-death-toll-from-recent-protests-rises-to-86-idUSKBN1XD0F6 (Reuters)]
*[[2019 Hong Kong protests]]
**Four people are injured at a mall as a knife-wielding man attacks a crowd in Hong Kong. The suspect, a [[Pro-Beijing camp (Hong Kong)|pro-Beijing]] [[Mandarin Chinese|Mandarin]] speaker, is subdued and arrested by police. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-china-50281914 (BBC News)]
*[[War in Afghanistan (2001–2021)]]
**At least nine Afghan security forces are killed in clashes with [[Taliban]] forces in northeastern [[Afghanistan]]. [https://www.wionews.com/south-asia/nine-afghan-security-officers-killed-in-taliban-ambush-259707 (WION)]

;Business and economy
*[[Saudi Vision 2030]]
**[[Saudi Aramco]] announces it will go public on the [[Tadawul|Riyadh stock exchange]], with [[Share (finance)|shares]] totalling up to two percent of the firm's worth made available at its [[Initial public offering|IPO]] launch. Valued at [[United States dollar|US$]]1.2 trillion, the company is being partially privatized to reduce the [[Saudi Arabia|kingdom]]'s [[Economy of Saudi Arabia|economic dependence]] on oil. [https://www.bbc.com/news/business-50070823 (BBC News)]
*[[McDonald's]] CEO [[Steve Easterbrook]] is fired for having a relationship with an employee. Current company president [[Chris Kempczinski]] immediately assumes his position. [https://www.bbc.com/news/business-50283720 (BBC News)]

;Disasters and accidents
*Thirty-three people are injured, four critically, when a [[FlixBus]] overturns at an exit near [[Amiens]], [[France]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-50283112 (BBC News)]

;Politics and elections
*[[2019 Venezuelan presidential crisis]]
**Following similar measures by [[Argentina]] last month, the government of [[El Salvador]] expels diplomats of the government of [[Venezuela]] led by [[Nicolás Maduro]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-50279917 (BBC News)]
*[[2019 Iraqi protests]]
**Protestors storm the [[Iran|Iranian]] consulate in [[Karbala]], where they set fires around the building and replaced the [[Flag of Iran|Iranian flag]] with an [[Flag of Iraq|Iraqi one]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/11/iraqi-protesters-attack-iran-consulate-karbala-191103232545555.html (Al Jazeera)]

;Sports
*[[2019 FIA Formula One World Championship]]
**[[Lewis Hamilton]] wins his sixth Driver's Championship title at the [[2019 United States Grand Prix]].
